seo.title: Collapse — a small, fast file compressor
seo.description: A small, fast, open-source file compressor for MacOS, Windows and Linux. Turn files and folders into 7z, ZIP or tar archives and back, from a desktop app or your terminal.

hero.lead: Drag in a file or a folder, pick a format, and get a smaller archive in seconds. 7z, ZIP and tar, in and out, from a desktop window or your terminal.
hero.tagline: Open source · Desktop app & CLI · 7z, ZIP, tar

download.title: Pick your platform.
download.unsigned: Builds are unsigned for now (MacOS: right-click → Open on first launch). Checksums live on the

systems.macos: Universal app · Apple Silicon & Intel · MacOS 10.15+

features.title: Everything you need to squeeze a file. Nothing you don't.

folders.title: Files & folders
folders.body: Compress a single file or a whole directory tree; the structure survives the round-trip.

formats.title: 7z · ZIP · tar
formats.body: Standard archives any other tool can open, with five levels to trade speed for size.

both.title: Compress & extract
both.body: It goes both ways: drop an archive back in and the format is detected for you.

modes.title: Two modes
modes.body: Compress on this machine, or hand the work to a Collapse server you run yourself when you would rather a stronger one did it. Pick per archive; local is the default.

interfaces.title: App & command line
interfaces.body: One engine behind a calm window and a terminal command, so clicking and scripting produce the same archive.

safe.title: Safe extraction
safe.body: An archive can never write outside the folder you picked, however it was crafted.

footer.meta: Open source · Desktop app & CLI · part of Cervantic
